title: Crypto 'Guaranteed Returns' Scam
caller: an 'investment advisor' from a messaging group

lines.speaker: Advisor
lines.text: Welcome to the VIP signals group! Our members are making 300% returns this month with zero risk.

lines.speaker: Advisor
lines.text: It's guaranteed. Our AI trading bot never loses. I'll personally mentor you so you don't miss out.

lines.speaker: Advisor
lines.text: Just deposit $500 in Bitcoin to this wallet to activate your account. The more you put in, the more you make.

lines.speaker: Advisor
lines.text: Of course! But this bonus window closes in one hour — act now. Don't tell your bank, they don't understand crypto and will only slow you down.
